findings.problem: A successful pixel decode does not prove exact-byte canonical metadata-free JPEG. Trailers, concatenated streams, excess JFIF payload and post-SOS COM are accepted and become trusted content identities while not entering detection.
findings.fix_needed: Validate the complete JPEG marker/entropy stream to its sole final EOI, reject metadata at all positions, and constrain permitted JFIF fields/length/no thumbnails without re-encoding. Ensure the exporter shared guard rejects the same channels.

closed_findings.problem: Marker-only card exclusion hides unrelated scene text
closed_findings.fix: No optional exclusions; face and text see every pixel

closed_findings.problem: Human decision could submit a different viewing copy digest
closed_findings.fix: Bounded no-follow decode/hash after decision before intent/RPC
